P969 [16, 64]kbps Mono Speech Clamp (Block 510kbps Stereo Bomb) · P970 🎉 [5, 25]% packetLossPerc LBRR FEC & Opus/G.711 Baseline
❌ Legacy Opus SDP fmtp Traps (510kbps Bomb & Dead FEC)
1. 510kbps Stereo Music Bomb or 6kbps Intelligibility Collapse
• Rogue SDP Answer sets maxaveragebitrate=510000;stereo=1
• Causes 12× egress bandwidth & 4× libopus CPU amplification
• Or forces 6kbps narrowband floor → ASR WER spikes +42%
2. Dead useinbandfec=1 (packetLossPerc=0%) & Missing G.711
• Negotiates useinbandfec=1 in SDP but leaves packetLossPerc = 0%
• libopus emits 0 LBRR FEC frames → 10% Wi-Fi loss drops syllables!
• Omitting mandatory G.711 fallback breaks PSTN trunk interop (488)
Enterprise Production Impact (Without P969–P970)
• Media gateway NIC/CPU exhausted by 510kbps stereo sessions
• Fake SDP FEC leaves weak-network calls completely unprotected
Verdict: BLOCK (510kbps Stereo Bomb / Unarmed 0% LBRR FEC)
✅ Deterministic Opus RFC 7874 / RFC 7587 Guards (P969–P970 🎉)
P969: [16000, 64000] bps Speech Ceiling & Mono-Only Lock
• Clamp SDP maxaveragebitrate strictly in [16000, 64000] bps
• Enforce stereo=0 & sprop-stereo=0 on AI voice dialogue legs
• Preserve 24kHz super-wideband fricatives at optimal 32kbps
• unboundedOpusBitrateOrStereoAmplificationViolations == 0
• Gate: evaluateWebrtcOpusRfc7587MaxaveragebitrateVoiceCeiling...()
P970 🎉 (P970 / 130th FAQ / 930 Tests): [5, 25]% LBRR FEC & Baseline
• Couple useinbandfec=1 with OPUS_SET_PACKET_LOSS_PERC([5, 25]%)
• Dynamically feed RTCP RR/TWCC fraction-lost into libopus CTL
• Enforce RFC 7874 mandatory Opus + G.711 (PCMU/PCMA) baseline
• inactiveInbandFecOrMissingBaselineCodecDrops == 0
• Gate: evaluateWebrtcRfc7874BidirectionalInbandFecActivation...()
Verdict: PASS ([16,64]kbps Mono · [5,25]% Active LBRR · 930 Tests 🎉)
